Migration.Name: Add support for fractional years and Asset Name
Migration.Comments: https://github.com/adempiere/adempiere/issues/4412 Runs after SeqNo 10590, which installs the corrected altercolumn() / t_alter_column infrastructure. The previous DBType="ALL" on the t_alter_column step was wrong: t_alter_column exists only in db/ddlutils/postgresql, so on Oracle it raised ORA-00942. The step is now split PostgreSQL / Oracle. Type and length only: NOT NULL is preserved.

Step.Comments: Widen UseLifeYears_F to unconstrained numeric, and a_asset.Name to varchar(255). Type/length only: NOT NULL is preserved.
Oracle has no t_alter_column; native MODIFY restates NOT NULL.
